description: This file implements functions related to color space conversions and definitions based on ITU-T H.273 standards, including retrieving primaries, transfer functions, and YUV color spaces.

methods.name: CICPGetPrimaries
methods.description: Retrieves the primary color space based on an input code, mapping to predefined primaries.

methods.name: CICPGetTransferFn
methods.description: Retrieves the transfer function based on an input code, considering sRGB preference.

methods.name: CICPGetSkColorSpace
methods.description: Constructs an SkColorSpace object based on primaries, transfer characteristics, matrix coefficients, and range flags.

methods.name: CICPGetSkYUVColorSpace
methods.description: Determines the YUV color space based on matrix coefficients, range, and bits per color.
